name: Osa
title: Hostler of the Caravanserai
examine: Sixty-some years, most of them opinions. Mules trust her on sight, which is the best character reference there is.
lines: Beasts watered, wheels mended, advice free and worth every penny.
I kept an inn at the ford for thirty years. My daughter keeps it now — Dunna, the Wanderer's Rest. Her stew wants thyme. You may quote me.
Walked the High Road at sixty, alone, uphill. Everyone said the road would kill me. The road and I had a nicer conversation than that.
